caption: The drawing depicts a metallic branding iron and its corresponding imprint. The branding iron is shown in a realistic and detailed manner, colored in tones of brown, blue, and gray suggesting a metallic surface. It consists of a long straight handle that extends into a flat circular end with a T-shaped support inside, attached to a pair of curved supports at its base. Below and to the right of the branding iron, there is a simple line rendering of the mark it produces: a large, open circle with a vertical line and a short horizontal line forming a T-shape at its center, and two curved lines extending downward from the bottom part of the circle. The background is plain and off-white, and the artist’s name, “Elizabeth Johnson,” is visible in the bottom right corner.
title: Branding Iron
